This is an incredibly long and difficult to digest document. I assume some of this will come as the document will be finalized, but please consider: 
- an executive summary
- a simpler reference architecture diagram - either instead of or in addition to the full diagram 3.2. There are many aspects there that are not critical to implementing DPI-H
- a simpler enterprise architecture diagram that guides chapter 4 (as a subset of the full DPI-H reference architecture)
- reducing the background, introductory, explanatory text throughout - some of these feel like "filler" content and could be shorter
